study_identification_part.si_4_title: Multivariate brain-  cognition associations in euthymic bipolar disorder

nm2_1_modeling_methods.detail: Generalised additive model used to regress age, sex, and scanning protocol (site as random effect) on cortical thickness for normative harmonisation.
nm2_1_modeling_methods.supporting_text: We harmonised the normative- HC data, including the 26 HCs recruited to BLISS, for each ROI by regressing age, sex and scanning protocol (i.e., site; as a random effect) on cortical thickness using a generalised additive model.
nm2_1_modeling_methods.location: Little2024.pdf.md: 2.4.2 | Normative model of cortical thickness

nm2_2_response_variable.detail: Cortical thickness measures for 68 ROIs (Desikan-Killiany atlas).
nm2_2_response_variable.supporting_text: cortical thickness measures were obtained for 68 anatomical regions of interest (ROIs) for each participant using the Desikan- Killiany atlas.

nm2_3_explanatory_variables.detail: Age, sex, and scanning protocol/site were used as predictors in the normative model of cortical thickness.
